text:
lina: Bringing up APAC1 telemetry landing zone today — will provision a small GPU pool + full observability stack (logs/metrics/traces). Quick sync?

tom: I'm free for 15. What's the target capacity for GPUs (g5 vs a100) and node count?

lina: Start with 4 g5.2xlarge-equivalent nodes (burst to 8 if autoscale). Want conservative to validate billing and network egress before scaling.

sanjay: Reminder: APAC1 has 100 Mbps per-ENI egress cap in our account until we request quota bump. That affects log shipping throughput if we send raw logs off-cluster.

eva: For Private deployments we need KMS keys for tracing metadata. Who's owning key creation?

ben: I'll create the IAM roles + KMS policy. Plan for collector to redact PII before export. Also: use Vector for logs (local batching) -> OTLP to OTel collector -> Thanos remote write for metrics.

lina: Good. Can we standardize on these helm charts/versions?

ben: Yes — notes I'm using the following in my test cluster:
```
helm repo add redwood-observability https://charts.redwood.example
helm install vector redwood-observability/vector --version 1.5.2 -n telemetry --set global.batchSize=500
helm install otelcol redwood-observability/opentelemetry-collector --version 0.8.1 -n telemetry
helm install prometheus redwood-observability/prometheus --version 2.31.1 -n telemetry
helm install grafana redwood-observability/grafana --version 9.4.0 -n telemetry
```
Replace charts with upstream if not available.

maya: Any validation checklist we can run after helm deploys? I'll take handoff once validated.

ben: Validation quick checks (run from jumpbox):
```
# pods Ready
kubectl -n telemetry get pods | grep -E "vector|otelcol|prometheus|grafana" 
# metrics scraping
curl -s http://prometheus.telemetry.svc:9090/api/v1/targets | jq '.data.activeTargets | length'
# logs flow (sample)
kubectl -n telemetry logs deploy/vector | tail -n 20
# trace export
curl -s http://otelcol.telemetry.svc:4318/v1/metrics | head
```
Expect non-zero targets and no `CrashLoopBackOff`. If egress is throttled, Vector will queue locally and you should see `enqueue` logs.

sanjay: Also validate network policies: ensure egress to our log-egress LB IPs and to the KMS endpoint. Quick `ip route` and `curl` checks in a pod are fine.

lina: Alerting templates — use these minimal ones for boot: high log queue growth, prometheus rule for alertmanager latency, and grafana dashboard heartbeat missing. Ben, can you push templates to infra repo?

ben: Pushed PR: github.com/redwood/infra/telemetry-templates/pull/12 — includes Alertmanager config + PrometheusRules. Example rule snippet:
```
- alert: VectorOutputBacklog
  expr: sum(vector_output_queue_length{job="vector"}) > 10000
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Vector backlog growing in {{ $labels.cluster }}"
```

infra-bot: Deployment job started: infra/telemetry-bootstrap (run id: 20240323-879). Logs -> https://ci.redwood.example/builds/20240323-879

tom: Do we have cost guardrails? Need a burn alert if GPU spend > $X/day for this region.

lina: Set temporary budget alert: daily GPU spend > $1200 triggers slack notification + ops email. Maya, add to handoff doc.

maya: On it. I'll run the validation checklist once CI finishes and then create the handoff ticket (TICKET-4521) with screenshots and Grafana folder link.

ben: One more runbook note: if Prometheus memory spikes on small nodes, flip to remote write immediately to Thanos receive — command:
```
kubectl -n telemetry patch statefulset prometheus --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"prometheus","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"2Gi"}}}]}}}}'
```

lina: Thanks everyone. Plan: wait for infra-bot CI success (~10m), ben will merge templates, maya will validate and take oncall handoff. Ping here when handoff complete. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: infra/telemetry-bootstrap completed successfully (id: 20240323-879) in 7m 12s.

maya: Validation done. All telemetry pods Ready, Prometheus targets = 28, Grafana folder created "APAC1 / Telemetry". Handoff ticket TICKET-4521 created and assigned to oncall. Leaving notes about egress quota and cost alert. :white_check_mark:
